caption: The drawing depicts a wallpaper design with a gray background featuring an arrangement of stylized floral and foliage motifs. The main design elements consist of light gray and white branches with elongated leaves, which have dark gray or black accents. Scattered along the branches are clusters of rounded flowers, outlined in white and filled with a pattern of red and black shapes. On the right side of the drawing, there is a vertical decorative border composed of a series of white oval shapes connected edge-to-edge, each oval containing a symmetric pattern of dots and lines. At the bottom center of the drawing, there is a beige rectangular label with black text that reads: "WALL DECORATION / LITCHFIELD, CONN. . . ABOUT 1778 / PLATE 5." The composition is arranged in a repeating, diagonal pattern of branches and flowers, while the border runs parallel to the right edge of the design.
title: Decorated Wall
